\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{ramseyclaim}{Ramsey Claim}
\newtheorem{enumlemma}[ramseyclaim]{Enumeration Lemma}
\begin{document}

\begin{ramseyclaim}
Every red/blue colouring of the edges of $K_6$ contains a monochromatic triangle.
\end{ramseyclaim}

\begin{enumlemma}
The number of subsets of $[n]$ of size $k$ is $\binom{n}{k}$.
\end{enumlemma}

% Also include a standard env to make sure both are caught.
\begin{theorem}
A bipartite graph has no odd cycles.
\end{theorem}
